steps.code:
# Get all playlists from the library (paginate through all pages)
access_token = login_response['access_token']
all_playlists = []
page_index = 0
while True:
    playlists_page = apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=20)
    if not playlists_page:
        break
    all_playlists.extend(playlists_page)
    if len(playlists_page) < 20:
        break
    page_index += 1

print(f"Total playlists: {len(all_playlists)}")
for p in all_playlists:
    print(p['playlist_id'], p['title'], p['song_ids'])
